assertions_evaluated.text: The review states that ! commands and @ includes expand when the command loads, so the !-validation cannot gate the @ include or the ! build
assertions_evaluated.evidence: review.md item 1: 'A ! backtick executes when the command loads, before Claude reads the If the validation passed condition'; item 2: the @ include 'injects the file at load time, whatever $0 is'.

assertions_evaluated.text: The fixed command validates the argument before any step that uses it, without relying on a load-time ! check to gate later load-time steps
assertions_evaluated.evidence: build-env.md step 1 compares $0 with dev, staging, prod as plain text and stops otherwise.

assertions_evaluated.text: The fixed command has no @ include whose path contains the argument; the config is read with the Read tool after validation
assertions_evaluated.evidence: No @ include; step 2 reads config/<environment>.json with the Read tool after validation.

assertions_evaluated.text: The fixed command treats the config contents as data, not instructions, and narrows the Read grant to the config files
assertions_evaluated.evidence: build-env.md has no statement that the config contents are data, and allowed-tools grants bare 'Read'.

assertions_evaluated.text: build.sh runs as a body step with the validated environment, not as a load-time ! command with the raw $0
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Step 3 runs bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/build.sh <environment> with the Bash tool, using the validated name.
